# Log Anomaly Detection

> Log parsing and anomaly detection for large clusters: a Drain parser with a Rust core, six detectors from PCA to a transformer, streaming alerts, and change-point detection for metric regressions, measured on Loghub, Loghub-2.0 and TCPD.

Languages: Python, Rust. License: MIT. Source: https://github.com/adeoluo/log-anomaly-detection

## Source

- [rust/src/drain.rs](https://github.com/adeoluo/log-anomaly-detection/blob/main/rust/src/drain.rs): Drain: the fixed-depth parse-tree log parser, identical to the Python reference in `src/log_anomaly_detection/drain.py`.
- [rust/src/lib.rs](https://github.com/adeoluo/log-anomaly-detection/blob/main/rust/src/lib.rs): Rust core of log-anomaly-detection.
- [rust/src/pipeline.rs](https://github.com/adeoluo/log-anomaly-detection/blob/main/rust/src/pipeline.rs): Log formats and batch or file parsing: header extraction, masking and tokenizing run in parallel chunks, then messages enter the (sequential) Drain tree in input order.
- [rust/src/python.rs](https://github.com/adeoluo/log-anomaly-detection/blob/main/rust/src/python.rs): PyO3 bindings, built by maturin into the `log_anomaly_rs` extension module.
- [src/log_anomaly_detection/__init__.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/log-anomaly-detection/blob/main/src/log_anomaly_detection/__init__.py): Log parsing and anomaly detection for large clusters.
- [src/log_anomaly_detection/backend.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/log-anomaly-detection/blob/main/src/log_anomaly_detection/backend.py): The Rust backend, compiled into the package on install and used by default.
- [src/log_anomaly_detection/changepoint.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/log-anomaly-detection/blob/main/src/log_anomaly_detection/changepoint.py): Change-point detection for performance-baseline regressions: CUSUM and Bayesian online CPD.
- [src/log_anomaly_detection/cli.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/log-anomaly-detection/blob/main/src/log_anomaly_detection/cli.py): Command line interface: ``python -m log_anomaly_detection <command>``.
- [src/log_anomaly_detection/configuration.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/log-anomaly-detection/blob/main/src/log_anomaly_detection/configuration.py): Typed service settings loaded from the environment (prefix ``LAD_``) or a ``.env`` file.
- [src/log_anomaly_detection/datasets.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/log-anomaly-detection/blob/main/src/log_anomaly_detection/datasets.py): Anomaly-detection datasets: HDFS sessions and BGL windows, parsed straight from the raw logs.
- [src/log_anomaly_detection/detectors/__init__.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/log-anomaly-detection/blob/main/src/log_anomaly_detection/detectors/__init__.py): Anomaly detectors over event counts (PCA, invariant mining, LogCluster, isolation forest).
- [src/log_anomaly_detection/detectors/base.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/log-anomaly-detection/blob/main/src/log_anomaly_detection/detectors/base.py): The detector interface shared by every model.
- [src/log_anomaly_detection/detectors/iforest.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/log-anomaly-detection/blob/main/src/log_anomaly_detection/detectors/iforest.py): Isolation forest (Liu, Ting and Zhou, ICDM 2008), implemented with numpy.
- [src/log_anomaly_detection/detectors/invariants.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/log-anomaly-detection/blob/main/src/log_anomaly_detection/detectors/invariants.py): Invariant mining (Lou et al., USENIX ATC 2010): sparse integer relations among event counts.
- [src/log_anomaly_detection/detectors/logcluster.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/log-anomaly-detection/blob/main/src/log_anomaly_detection/detectors/logcluster.py): LogCluster (Lin et al., ICSE 2016): cluster normal sequences, flag rows far from every cluster.
- [src/log_anomaly_detection/detectors/pca.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/log-anomaly-detection/blob/main/src/log_anomaly_detection/detectors/pca.py): PCA anomaly detection (Xu et al., SOSP 2009) with the squared prediction error statistic.
- [src/log_anomaly_detection/detectors/sequence.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/log-anomaly-detection/blob/main/src/log_anomaly_detection/detectors/sequence.py): Next-event sequence detectors: DeepLog (Du et al., CCS 2017) and a transformer variant.
- [src/log_anomaly_detection/drain.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/log-anomaly-detection/blob/main/src/log_anomaly_detection/drain.py): Drain, the fixed-depth parse-tree log parser (He et al., ICWS 2017): reference implementation.
- [src/log_anomaly_detection/evaluation.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/log-anomaly-detection/blob/main/src/log_anomaly_detection/evaluation.py): Anomaly-detection evaluation: chronological split, normal-only training, test scoring.
- [src/log_anomaly_detection/features.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/log-anomaly-detection/blob/main/src/log_anomaly_detection/features.py): Feature extraction: event sequences per session or time window, and event count matrices.
- [src/log_anomaly_detection/formats.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/log-anomaly-detection/blob/main/src/log_anomaly_detection/formats.py): Log line formats and the per-dataset parser settings used by the Loghub benchmarks.
- [src/log_anomaly_detection/loghub.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/log-anomaly-detection/blob/main/src/log_anomaly_detection/loghub.py): Loghub parsing benchmarks: locate datasets, parse them, score them, time them.
- [src/log_anomaly_detection/metrics.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/log-anomaly-detection/blob/main/src/log_anomaly_detection/metrics.py): Detection metrics: precision, recall, F1, ROC AUC and average precision, vectorized.
- [src/log_anomaly_detection/observability.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/log-anomaly-detection/blob/main/src/log_anomaly_detection/observability.py): Thread-safe request and pipeline metrics, exported in the Prometheus text format.
- [src/log_anomaly_detection/parser.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/log-anomaly-detection/blob/main/src/log_anomaly_detection/parser.py): High-level log parsing: one API over the Rust core and the Python reference.
- [src/log_anomaly_detection/parsing_metrics.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/log-anomaly-detection/blob/main/src/log_anomaly_detection/parsing_metrics.py): Log parsing accuracy metrics, computed exactly as the Loghub-2.0 benchmark computes them.
- [src/log_anomaly_detection/service.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/log-anomaly-detection/blob/main/src/log_anomaly_detection/service.py): HTTP service (standard library): parse lines, ingest a stream, score sessions, find regressions.
- [src/log_anomaly_detection/streaming.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/log-anomaly-detection/blob/main/src/log_anomaly_detection/streaming.py): Streaming detection: parse lines as they arrive, close sessions, score them, raise alerts.
